main_text.p: firmatio hæc erit:Nó est una pecunia , propterea quòd altera jã erat pupilli aduétitia: cuius heres nõ illo in testamẽto qsquã scriptus erat, si quid pupillo accidisset: & de altera patris etiã nũc mortui vo-lũtas plurimũ valebat,quęeã[?] mortuo pupillo suis heredib. concedebat. Judicatio est,unáne pecunia fuerit. Acsihac usi erunt infirmatione, posse plures esse unius heredes pecunię dissimilib. de causis:de eo ipso judicatio nascitur,posse plures eiusdem pecunię plures dissimilib.generibus heredes esse?Eiusmodi controversia illa est, de qua Jauolenus scri-

page.notes: Printed "«" marks stand at the right end of each line; they are printed marks, not words, so they are not transcribed. Handwritten annotation in the right margin (about "Aliud") is not printed and is left out. A thin show-through strip at the left edge is left out. Doubtful: "quęeã" (the word after "etiã nũc mortui" may read differently; the first letters are uncertain). Long s is printed as plain s throughout and "eft" is read as "est". The text in the running head and the page number 155 are as printed. The sentence "posse plures eiusdem pecunię plures dissimilib.generibus heredes esse" is as printed and may contain a printing error; it has been left as set. The line ends with "scri-" at the foot of the page, so the hyphen is kept and no catchword is printed.
